name: The Great Commission
overview: The Great Commission reveals Christ's authoritative command to His disciples to actively engage in making disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the triune name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, as Jesus declared that all power in heaven and earth has been given to Him. This mission underscores the urgency of the harvest being plentiful yet the laborers few, calling believers to respond as Isaiah did, willing to be sent by God. Jesus' instruction to preach the gospel to every creature throughout the world emphasizes the global scope and inclusive nature of this divine mandate.
